t_advice_summary_textbox.text: It is okay to ignore the types of gnomes, when it shows 1 point it is likely to be a large number of mushrooms. If a red basket is shown select red or purple gnome following up

vb_textbox.text: Go with your gut on the gnomes I would aim towards the red or green when given the option, the 1 point usually means a large number of mushrooms will follow. If a red basket is shown it is sensible to select a red or purple gnome when it follows. Try not to wait too long or you will miss a turn.
